subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should this remain the canonical narrow Google Chat Space @mention/session bug, or should maintainers fold it into the broader Google Chat Spaces/threading work with the mention-gating evidence preserved?
rationale: Source and release evidence show the classifier fix shipped, but the remaining behavior depends on live Google Chat annotation semantics and a product choice about mention fallback safety versus broader Space routing consolidation.

options.title: Keep Narrow Bug Open
options.body: Track a focused plugin-owned repair for Google Chat Space @mention detection and group session creation here, while broader receive-all/thread routing stays separate.

options.title: Consolidate Into Spaces Work
options.body: Move the current live mention-gating evidence into the broader Google Chat Spaces/threading issue and make that item explicitly own this narrower regression too.

options.title: Wait For Live Payload Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open with no fix lane until a maintainer gets redacted current-release webhook annotation payloads and logs.

recommendation.title: Keep Narrow Bug Open
recommendation.body: Track a focused plugin-owned repair for Google Chat Space @mention detection and group session creation here, while broader receive-all/thread routing stays separate.

likelyOwner.reason: They landed the partial classifier fix and explicitly kept this broader Space/group behavior open, making them the best current router for the remaining decision.
